t: This is the Wallace fountain in Manchester Square, outside the Wallace Collection. It's a former drinking fountain. It was made by Charles-Auguste Lebourg, a French sculptor who is best known for designing the Wallace fountains. Those fountains stand in virtually every quarter of Paris and in cities around the world, so this is one of a famous family. Lebourg also made many bronze and marble statues and busts, and his work won recognition at Salons and World's Fairs in the later nineteenth century. You can see more of it at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris.
